node.statement: For X=sum_{j,k}X_jk, exact source cornering gives (X^dagger)_kj=X_jk^dagger and ||X_jk||<=||X||. Hence gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger=sum_{j,k}[gamma_kj,n(X_jk^dagger)-gamma_jk,n(X_jk)^dagger]. Each bracket has norm at most rho||X_jk|| by the datum involution-compatibility clause, so the triangle inequality gives at most rho sum_{j,k}||X_jk||<=4rho||X||. This is a defect estimate, not an exact equality.
